verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms the vendor publishes an llms.txt at https://learn.chatgpt.com/llms.txt, which returns HTTP 200 and is described as a compact index an agent can be pointed at. The cited documentation pages are themselves served at .md URLs, giving agents markdown-format docs. The llms.txt content is headed 'Codex', so its coverage of the wider ChatGPT product is unclear. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers all ChatGPT docs beyond Codex, any first-party documentation of the llms.txt or markdown-docs offering, an llms-full or equivalent complete export, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
